headline: Executive order directs federal efforts to improve education for American Indian and Alaska Native students and to support tribal colleges.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses federal attention on education for American Indian and Alaska Native students. It also aims to strengthen tribal colleges and universities. No summary was provided, so the specific programs, offices, or steps it sets up cannot be described here.
